| [QUESTION-077](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-077.md) | Is agreement among an agent's interests produced by coupling, as when each sees and follows the current majority, a different kind of integration from agreement because their valuations coincide? | Drawn by the assistant from [CASE-074](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-074.md) and filed at the owner's request. [CLAIM-162](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-162.md) defines synchronization as valuations that coincide. The question is whether agreement by coupling is a third route to acting as one, beside agreement by coinciding valuation (flow) and a change in which interest may act ([CLAIM-156](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-156.md)). | Open |
| [QUESTION-131](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-131.md) | How does structural frustration among jointly incompatible demands relate to operative thwarting of a constituent's demands, and under what conditions can one occur without the other? | Raised in the reviews the owner relayed on 2026-10-18, after the filing of the exchange of 2026-10-17. Structural frustration has a settled formal definition: a collection of demands is structurally frustrated when no outcome attainable under the specified constraints meets them all, S ∉ 𝒦(𝒪; D) ([CLAIM-347](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-347.md)). What is open is how it relates to operative thwarting, where a particular constituent's live demand is counteracted by an identifiable constraint or countervailing process. Physics frustration ([CLAIM-153](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-153.md)) is the structural sense, and self-determination theory's need thwarting ([THEORY-052](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-052.md)) the operative one. An answer says when structural incompatibility shows up as thwarting, whether thwarting can occur where joint satisfaction is possible, and what evidence attributes either to a bearer. Merely failing to realize an attainable set of requirements is neither. | Open |
| [QUESTION-267](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-267.md) | When the ordering that prevails a system's negotiation ranks its states by a proxy for its maintenance rather than by its maintenance, as a firm's potential metric may, is that valence, and is it the form that metric fixation in organizations and addiction in persons share? | [TERM-076](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-076.md) restricts valence to an ordering serving as the negotiation's potential of the system's own states by their bearing on its maintenance. A potential ordering can instead rank them by a proxy that has come apart from maintenance. Wells Fargo's cross-sell metric ([CASE-151](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-151.md)) is a candidate: treated as the firm's standing, it was not its viability. The question is whether such potential is valence, and whether it is a common form of organizational metric fixation and of addiction. | Open |
| [QUESTION-269](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-269.md) | Does the potential account of valence need the will-organization's other relations, accessibility, jurisdiction, suspension and transformation, beside the priority, persistence and resumption it reads off which side wins, and does a system's valence change when one of them changes and the record of wins does not? | From the comparison of the record's will and affect lines of 2026-10-23, filed at the owner's direction. Will-organization ([TERM-023](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-023.md)) has six relations, and [CLAIM-057](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-057.md) shows three of them vary independently. The potential account ([TERM-076](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-076.md), [TERM-078](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-078.md)) reads valence from wins alone, through Frijda's three marks. | [QUESTION-301](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-301.md) | Is acting for one's legacy, for how one is remembered or for people who will live after one's death, self-interest on a self extended in time, as collectivism on the owner's thesis is self-interest on a self extended across people? | The owner's angle of 2026-10-29, opened by Johnston's Surviving Death, whose good person lives on in "the onward rush of humankind". The owner's thesis ([CLAIM-491](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-491.md)) enlarges the self across people; legacy enlarges it across time, past death. Psychology measures the temporal extent the way it measures the social one (overlap circles for the future self), and finds legacy motivation drives concern for future generations. Philosophy offers three readings of that concern: an extended self, interests that outlast death (Pitcher), and dependence on a future we will not see (Scheffler). | Open |
